auth.sign_in_intro: Geli iimaylkaaga iyo furaha sirta. Akoon ma lihid?
auth.sign_up_intro: Bilow tijaabadaada bilaashka ah. Akoon ma leedahay?
auth.slug_hint: Menu-gaagu wuxuu ahaan doonaa {{url}}. Xarfo yaryar, tirooyin iyo xariijin.
auth.forgot_intro: Geli iimaylkaaga, waxaan kuu soo diri doonnaa xiriiriye aad ku doorato furo cusub.
auth.reset_link_sent: Haddii akoon u jiro {{email}}, xiriiriye dib-u-dejin ayaa kuu socda. Eeg sanduuqaaga iyo spam-ka.
auth.password_changed: Furaha sirta waa la beddelay. Ku gal furahaaga cusub.
auth.reset_link_invalid: Xiriiriyahan dib-u-dejinta waa dhiman yahay ama wuu dhacay.
auth.two_factor_intro: Geli koodhka 6-da god ah ee ka yimid app-ka xaqiijinta.
auth.session_expired: Fadhigaagu wuu dhammaaday. Fadlan mar kale gal.
auth.legal: Markaad sii wadato waxaad ogolaatay <terms>Shuruudaha Adeegga</terms> iyo <privacy>Siyaasadda Asturnaanta</privacy>.

validation.slug: Isticmaal 3–50 xaraf yar, tiro iyo xariijin keli ah, aan bilowga ama dhammaadka ahayn.

verify.banner: Fadlan xaqiiji iimaylkaaga ({{email}}) adigoo isticmaalaya xiriiriyaha aan kuu dirnay.

invite.title: Ku biir {{restaurant}}

team.title: Kooxda

role_hint.manager: Maamulayaashu waxay beddelaan menu-ga, laamaha iyo dejinta, waxayna casuumi karaan shaqaale.
role_hint.staff: Shaqaaluhu waxay calaamadiyaan alaabta dhammaatay. U oggolow inay qiimaha beddelaan haddii loo baahdo.

team.invite_intro: Waxaan u diri doonnaa xiriiriye ku shaqeeya 7 maalmood.
team.remove_confirm: Ka saar {{name}} kooxda? Isla markiiba wuu lumin doonaa gelitaanka.
team.leave_confirm: Ka tag {{restaurant}}? Waxaad u baahan doontaa casuumad cusub si aad u soo noqoto.

errors.in_progress: Weli waxaa la kaydinayaa isbeddelkii hore. Isku day dhawaan.
errors.too_many: Isku dayo aad u badan. Sug daqiiqad oo isku day mar kale.
